system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature, [Corrosive Branch]

You radiate a corrosive aura so potent, creatures within your vicinity can sense their defenses failing them as a result of your very presence.

While in combat, hostile creatures that end their turn within 15 feet of you, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your Highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, their AC is reduced by 1, for the next minute. A creature that passes this saving throw by 10 or more gains immunity to it until you complete a rest.

Additionally, jutsu cast by hostile creatures with the Barrier keyword within 15 feet of you, that rolls dice to determine their effects or hit points, roll half their listed value.
